instructions: Are the arguments given to the tool sufficient for the tool to run, or are key parameters missing or empty?

options.label: complete
options.criterion: every argument the tool needs to do its job is present and non-empty

options.label: missing
options.criterion: at least one required argument is empty, unset, or a placeholder

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the tool and arguments are not enough to tell whether anything is missing
